units.quote: 8 FAM 403.1-4 Material Discrepancies (Major name changes)
units.meaning: Provides the section title establishing the subject as material discrepancies and major name changes; contains no independent operational requirement or rule.
Provides administrative version and revision date metadata without substantive legal or procedural obligation.

units.quote: A material discrepancy is any name change that is not defined as immaterial in 8 FAM 403.1-5.
units.meaning: Defines a material discrepancy as any name change that does not qualify as immaterial under 8 FAM 403.1-5.

units.quote: The applicant must explain any material discrepancies between the name on the application and the name recorded in the evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality and the evidence of identity (see 22 CFR 51.25).
units.meaning: Applicants are required to provide an explanation for any material discrepancies between their application name, citizenship/nationality evidence name, and identity evidence name.

units.quote: Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section
units.meaning: Applicants must document material discrepancies among the application name, citizenship/nationality evidence, or identity evidence by submitting at least one acceptable document specified in the section.

units.quote: see an exception for married names in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C)
units.meaning: Directs to an exception from the material discrepancy documentation rules for married names set forth in 8 FAM 403.1-4(C).
scope_quotes: b. Material discrepancies between the name recorded on the application, the applicant's evidence of U.S. citizenship/non-citizen U.S. nationality, or the evidence of identity must be documented by submission of one or more of the documents listed in this section

units.quote: Court orders or decrees:
units.meaning: Identifies court orders or decrees as an acceptable category of documentation for establishing a material name change.
scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):

units.quote: Name change orders;
units.meaning: Specifies name change orders as an acceptable type of court order or decree for documenting a material name change.
scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):

units.quote: Divorce decrees;
units.meaning: Specifies divorce decrees as an acceptable type of court order or decree for documenting a material name change.
scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):

units.quote: (2) Certificates of naturalization;
units.meaning: Identifies certificates of naturalization as an acceptable category of documentation to establish a material name change.
scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):

units.quote: (3) Marriage certificates;
units.meaning: Identifies marriage certificates as an acceptable category of documentation to establish a material name change.
scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):

units.quote: (4) Documentation demonstrating change of name by operation of state law; or
units.meaning: Identifies documentation demonstrating a name change occurred by operation of state law as an acceptable means of documenting a material name change.
scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):

units.quote: (5) Documentation of customary usage.
units.meaning: Identifies documentation of customary usage as an acceptable means of documenting a material name change.
scope_quotes: Acceptable means of documenting a material name change include (per 22 CFR 51.25):

units.quote: NOTE: Evidence of material name changes must be reviewed for evidence of counterfeiting or alteration (see 8 FAM 201.1)
units.meaning: Passport personnel must examine all evidence submitted for material name changes to check for counterfeiting or alteration.

units.quote: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change
units.meaning: Applicants are prohibited from continuing to use a former name once a material name change has occurred.

units.quote: unless the name change documentation specifically permits the applicant to continue using that name (see 8 FAM 403.1-6 regarding “known as” names).
units.meaning: Permits an applicant to continue using a previous name after a material name change if the documentation of the name change explicitly authorizes continued use.
scope_quotes: The applicant may not continue to use a previous name after a material name change

units.quote: The applicant's name is an integral part of her/his identity.
units.meaning: Articulates the foundational principle that an individual's name is an essential component of identity; contains no independent mandate.

units.quote: Consequently, under 22 CFR 51.23(c), evidence of identity might be required in accordance with Department guidance to establish the name that best identifies the applicant:
units.meaning: States that Department guidance may require identity evidence under 22 CFR 51.23(c) to confirm which name best identifies the applicant.

units.quote: more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11
units.meaning: Establishes a timing threshold of greater than one year between the occurrence of a material name change and submission of a Form DS-11 application.
scope_quotes: (1) If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

units.quote: If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.
units.meaning: Adjudicators are required to suspend the application and request acceptable ID reflecting the new name if the applicant's material name change took place over a year before filing Form DS-11 and their ID has not been updated.

units.quote: If there is insufficient time to request that the applicant submit acceptable ID prior to urgent or emergency travel, a limited-validity passport may be issued in the requested name;
units.meaning: Allows issuance of a limited-validity passport in the requested name when urgent or emergency travel leaves inadequate time to obtain acceptable updated ID.
scope_quotes: (1) If the applicant has had a material name change more than one year prior to applying on form DS-11 but has not updated her/his ID to reflect the material name change, you must suspend the application to request an acceptable ID in the new name.

units.quote: The applicant generally will need the name change documentation to change the name on her/his ID.
units.meaning: States the general expectation that an applicant requires their name change documentation in order to update the name on their identification.

units.quote: You must fully notate the name change documentation prior to returning the documentation, including that the documentation was "seen and returned," to the applicant with the information request letter (IRL); and
units.meaning: Mandates that adjudicators thoroughly notate name change documentation, specifically recording that it was 'seen and returned,' before sending it back with an Information Request Letter (IRL).

units.quote: within one year of applying on a form DS-11
units.meaning: Defines a temporal window of one year or less between a material name change and application on Form DS-11.
scope_quotes: (3) Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.

units.quote: Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.
units.meaning: Exempts applicants from having to provide identification in their new name if their material name change occurred within one year of applying on Form DS-11.

units.quote: However, if the ID has not yet been changed, they must submit their name change documentation.
units.meaning: Requires applicants whose name change occurred within one year of applying to submit their name change documentation if their ID has not yet been updated.
scope_quotes: (3) Applicants who have had a material name change within one year of applying on a form DS-11 do not need to submit ID in the new name.
